title: The most far away place people live

sentences.text: In the middle of the South Atlantic
there is a very small island.
About two hundred and fifty people live on it.
sentences.translationRu: На нём живёт около двухсот пятидесяти человек.

sentences.text: It is called Tristan da Cunha.
It is the farthest place from anywhere.
sentences.translationRu: Это самое удалённое от всего место.

sentences.text: The nearest land with people
is more than two thousand kilometres away.
sentences.translationRu: находится больше чем в двух тысячах километров.

sentences.text: There is no airport.
There is nowhere flat enough for one.
sentences.translationRu: И нет ровного места, чтобы его построить.

sentences.text: The island is the top of a volcano.
To get there you take a boat.
The journey is six or seven days.
And boats do not go often.
Maybe eight or nine times a year.
sentences.translationRu: Может быть, восемь-девять раз в год.

sentences.text: If you are ill, you wait.
There is a doctor, and one small hospital.
sentences.translationRu: Врач есть, и одна маленькая больница.

sentences.text: For anything serious, you wait for a ship.
Everybody on the island has one of eight names.
sentences.translationRu: У всех на острове одна из восьми фамилий.

sentences.text: Family names, from the first people there.
They came about two hundred years ago.
sentences.translationRu: Они пришли примерно двести лет назад.

sentences.text: Everybody is a farmer.
The land is shared by everyone.
Nobody can buy it or sell it.
You cannot move there.
Not unless you marry somebody from the island.
sentences.translationRu: Разве что женившись на ком-то оттуда.

sentences.text: In 1961 the volcano started again.
Everybody left on ships.
They lived in England for two years.
sentences.translationRu: Два года они жили в Англии.

sentences.text: Then they voted.
Almost all of them wanted to go home.
England was warm and full of shops.
sentences.translationRu: Англия была тёплой и полной магазинов.

sentences.text: They went back to the island anyway.
sentences.translationRu: Они всё равно вернулись на остров.

sentences.text: The internet arrived only recently.
It is slow, and everybody shares it.
sentences.translationRu: Он медленный, и он общий для всех.

sentences.text: People there say the same thing to visitors.
sentences.translationRu: Гостям там говорят одно и то же.

sentences.text: They do not feel far away.
Everybody else does.

title: How a falling cat turns around

sentences.text: Drop a cat upside down and it lands on its feet.
sentences.translationRu: Отпусти кошку спиной вниз — она приземлится на лапы.

sentences.text: Everybody knows this.
For a long time nobody could explain it.
sentences.translationRu: Долго никто не мог это объяснить.

sentences.text: It looked impossible.
Here is why.
To turn, you usually push against something.
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы повернуться, обычно надо от чего-то оттолкнуться.

sentences.text: The ground, a wall, water.
A falling cat is touching nothing.
There is nothing to push against.
And yet it turns.
sentences.translationRu: И тем не менее она переворачивается.

sentences.text: In 1894 a scientist filmed it.
sentences.translationRu: В 1894 году учёный снял это на плёнку.

sentences.text: Sixty pictures in one second.
Then he watched it very slowly.
And the answer was there.
The cat does not turn as one piece.
It bends in the middle.
So it becomes two parts.
Then it pulls the front legs in close.
And pushes the back legs out wide.
A small thing turns easily.
A wide thing turns slowly.
So the front spins a lot.
And the back spins only a little.
Then the cat swaps them.
Back legs in, front legs out.
Now the back spins around.
Two movements, and the cat is facing down.
sentences.translationRu: Два движения — и кошка смотрит вниз.

sentences.text: It needs a little height to do this.
Under about thirty centimetres, there is no time.
Then it opens its legs wide.
Like a parachute, to slow down.
And it bends its legs when it lands.
Which spreads the hit over more time.
Gymnasts and divers do the same thing.
sentences.translationRu: Гимнасты и прыгуны в воду делают то же самое.

sentences.text: Pull in to spin faster.
Open out to stop.
The cat was doing it first.

title: A fridge does not make cold

sentences.text: A fridge keeps food cold.
So it must be making cold.
That is the obvious reading, and it is wrong.
There is no such thing as cold.
Cold is the absence of heat.
So a fridge does not add anything.
It removes heat, and puts it somewhere else.
sentences.translationRu: Он забирает тепло и уносит его в другое место.

sentences.text: That place is your kitchen.
Put your hand behind a fridge.
sentences.translationRu: Приложи руку к задней стенке холодильника.

sentences.text: It is warm.
That warmth was inside, on your food.
sentences.translationRu: Это тепло было внутри, на твоей еде.

sentences.text: The trick is a liquid that boils easily.
sentences.translationRu: Фокус — в жидкости, которая легко кипит.

sentences.text: Water boils at a hundred degrees.
This liquid boils far below zero.
sentences.translationRu: Эта жидкость кипит далеко ниже нуля.

sentences.text: Boiling needs energy.
It takes that energy from whatever is near.
sentences.translationRu: И берёт её у того, что рядом.

sentences.text: This is why sweating cools you.
Water leaving your skin takes heat with it.
A fridge does the same thing in a loop.
sentences.translationRu: Холодильник делает то же самое по кругу.

sentences.text: Inside the cold part, the liquid boils.
It becomes gas and it takes heat with it.
sentences.translationRu: Она становится газом и забирает тепло.

sentences.text: The food gets colder.
Then the gas goes to a pump.
The pump squeezes it hard.
Squeezing a gas makes it hot.
Now it is hotter than your kitchen.
It runs through pipes at the back.
And the heat leaves into the room.
The gas becomes liquid again.
Then it goes back inside to boil.
sentences.translationRu: И возвращается внутрь, чтобы снова кипеть.

sentences.text: Round and round, all day.
This is why you cannot cool a room
by leaving the fridge door open.
The heat comes out of the back
faster than the cold comes out of the front.
The pump itself makes heat too.
So the room gets slowly warmer.
sentences.translationRu: Так что комната будет медленно теплеть.

title: How a ball bends in the air

sentences.text: A free kick leaves the boot heading wide.
sentences.translationRu: Штрафной уходит с бутсы мимо ворот.

sentences.text: The wall relaxes. The keeper waits.
Then the ball comes back.
It bends inside the post.
Nothing pushed it.
The effect has a name and a mechanism.
sentences.translationRu: У эффекта есть имя и механизм.

sentences.text: It works on any spinning ball.
sentences.translationRu: Он работает на любом вращающемся мяче.

sentences.text: Football, tennis, cricket, table tennis.
A ball moving through air
drags a thin layer of it along its surface.
sentences.translationRu: тащит за собой тонкий слой у поверхности.

sentences.text: If the ball is also spinning,
that layer is dragged around with it.
sentences.translationRu: этот слой прокручивается вместе с ним.

sentences.text: So on one side of the ball
the spin moves with the oncoming air.
sentences.translationRu: вращение идёт по ходу набегающего воздуха.

sentences.text: On the other side it moves against it.
Those two sides are no longer the same.
sentences.translationRu: И две стороны перестают быть одинаковыми.

sentences.text: On the side moving with the air,
the air flows faster and clings longer.
sentences.translationRu: воздух течёт быстрее и держится дольше.

sentences.text: On the other side it separates early.
The whole wake behind the ball tilts.
Air is being thrown to one side.
And the ball is pushed to the other.
That is the entire mechanism.
Which explains a few things at once.
A ball with no spin does not bend.
It does something worse.
With no spin, the separation is unstable.
It flips from one side to the other.
sentences.translationRu: Он перескакивает с одной стороны на другую.

sentences.text: So the ball wobbles unpredictably.
Which is what a knuckleball is.
sentences.translationRu: Это и есть «сухой лист» без вращения.

sentences.text: Goalkeepers hate it more than any curve.
sentences.translationRu: Вратари ненавидят его больше любой крученой подачи.

sentences.text: A curve is predictable if you read the spin.
A wobble cannot be read at all.
Surface matters as much as spin.
A rough ball grips more air.
Which is why a tennis ball is fuzzy.
And why a very smooth football
sentences.translationRu: И поэтому очень гладкий футбольный мяч

sentences.text: bends less and wobbles more.
Players noticed that before physicists confirmed it.
sentences.translationRu: Игроки заметили это раньше, чем физики подтвердили.

title: Coffee does not give you energy

sentences.text: Coffee is usually described as energy.
It contains almost none.
A black coffee has about two calories.
sentences.translationRu: В чёрном кофе около двух калорий.

sentences.text: Whatever it is doing, it is not fuel.
sentences.translationRu: Что бы он ни делал, топливом он не является.

sentences.text: What it does is block a message.
While you are awake, your brain works.
Working produces a waste substance.
It builds up hour after hour.
Receptors detect how much has gathered.
And the more they detect, the sleepier you feel.
sentences.translationRu: И чем больше они улавливают, тем сильнее клонит в сон.

sentences.text: That is the body's clock for tiredness.
Not the hour on the wall. The level in the blood.
sentences.translationRu: Не час на стене. Уровень в крови.

sentences.text: Caffeine is shaped like that substance.
sentences.translationRu: Кофеин по форме похож на это вещество.

sentences.text: Close enough to fit the same receptor.
sentences.translationRu: Достаточно похож, чтобы войти в тот же рецептор.

sentences.text: But it does not trigger it.
It simply sits in the space
and leaves nowhere for the real signal to land.
sentences.translationRu: и не оставляет посадочной площадки настоящему сигналу.

sentences.text: So the message never arrives.
You do not feel less tired.
You stop being told that you are.
sentences.translationRu: Тебе просто перестают об этом сообщать.

sentences.text: The substance keeps building the whole time.
sentences.translationRu: А вещество всё это время продолжает копиться.

sentences.text: This is why the afternoon crash exists.
Caffeine leaves the body slowly.
Half of it is still there five or six hours later.
sentences.translationRu: Половина ещё на месте через пять-шесть часов.

sentences.text: When it finally clears,
every receptor becomes free at once.
And a much larger amount of signal
arrives in one go.
That is the crash. It is arithmetic.
sentences.translationRu: Это и есть провал. Это арифметика.

sentences.text: The five-hour figure explains something else.
A coffee at four in the afternoon
is still a quarter present at midnight.
People who say it does not affect their sleep
sentences.translationRu: Те, кто говорит, что на их сон он не влияет,

sentences.text: are often right about falling asleep.
And wrong about the depth of it.
Measured sleep shows less deep sleep
sentences.translationRu: Измеренный сон показывает меньше глубоких фаз

sentences.text: in people who felt entirely fine.
sentences.translationRu: у людей, которые чувствовали себя прекрасно.

sentences.text: Which is the difficulty with the whole subject.
sentences.translationRu: В этом и вся сложность темы.

sentences.text: The thing that measures your tiredness
is the thing you have just switched off.
sentences.translationRu: — это ровно то, что ты только что выключил.

sentences.text: Close your eyes and imagine an apple.
Most people see something.
Not like real sight, but something.
sentences.translationRu: Не как настоящее зрение, но что-то.

sentences.text: A shape, a colour, a suggestion of one.
Somewhere between one and four people in a hundred
sentences.translationRu: От одного до четырёх человек из ста

sentences.text: see absolutely nothing.
Not a faint image. Not a dim one.
Darkness, and the knowledge of an apple.
The condition has a name now: aphantasia.
sentences.translationRu: У этого состояния теперь есть имя: афантазия.

sentences.text: The name is about ten years old.
Which is the extraordinary part.
This is not rare enough to be exotic.
sentences.translationRu: Оно не настолько редко, чтобы быть экзотикой.

sentences.text: Millions of people have it.
And almost nobody noticed until recently.
sentences.translationRu: И почти никто до недавнего времени не замечал.

sentences.text: The reason is that nobody compares.
sentences.translationRu: Причина в том, что никто не сравнивает.

sentences.text: Language hides it completely.
Everyone says picture this and I see what you mean.
sentences.translationRu: Все говорят «представь себе» и «я вижу, о чём ты».

sentences.text: Somebody with no images says the same words.
sentences.translationRu: Человек без образов говорит те же слова.

sentences.text: And assumes they are a figure of speech.
Which, for them, they are.
sentences.translationRu: Для него они ею и являются.

sentences.text: Most people discover it in adulthood.
Usually in a conversation that goes wrong.
sentences.translationRu: Обычно в разговоре, который идёт не так.

sentences.text: Somebody insists they actually see the apple.
sentences.translationRu: Кто-то настаивает, что действительно видит яблоко.

sentences.text: And the other person realises, at forty,
sentences.translationRu: А другой в сорок лет понимает,

sentences.text: that this was never a metaphor.
sentences.translationRu: что это никогда не было метафорой.

sentences.text: What is striking is how little it costs.
sentences.translationRu: Поражает то, как мало это стоит.

sentences.text: People with aphantasia are not worse at memory.
sentences.translationRu: Люди с афантазией не хуже помнят.

sentences.text: They remember facts about a scene rather than the scene.
sentences.translationRu: Они помнят факты о сцене, а не саму сцену.

sentences.text: Which works nearly as well for most purposes.
sentences.translationRu: И для большинства задач это работает почти так же.

sentences.text: They are represented among artists and engineers.
sentences.translationRu: Они есть и среди художников, и среди инженеров.

sentences.text: Some report an advantage.
Distressing memories are less vivid
because nothing plays back.
There is a wider point in all of this.
We describe inner experience with shared words.
sentences.translationRu: Мы описываем внутренний опыт общими словами.

sentences.text: And assume the words describe the same thing.
sentences.translationRu: И считаем, что слова описывают одно и то же.

sentences.text: There is no way to check.
You cannot hand somebody your mental image
sentences.translationRu: Нельзя передать кому-то свой мысленный образ

sentences.text: and ask whether it matches theirs.
sentences.translationRu: и спросить, совпадает ли он с его.

sentences.text: So a difference this large
stayed invisible for the whole of human history.
Until somebody thought to ask.

title: Why you can see through glass and not through sand

sentences.text: Glass is made from sand.
Sand is completely opaque.
Heat it, and it becomes transparent.
sentences.translationRu: Нагрей его — и он станет прозрачным.

sentences.text: Nothing has been added.
The same atoms, rearranged.
So transparency is not about the substance.
It is about two separate things.
The first is whether light is absorbed.
Light is absorbed when its energy
matches a jump an electron can make.
sentences.translationRu: совпадает со скачком, который может сделать электрон.

sentences.text: In a metal, electrons are free.
Almost any energy fits something.
sentences.translationRu: Почти любая энергия под что-то подходит.

sentences.text: So light is absorbed immediately.
In glass, the electrons are tightly held.
The smallest jump available
needs more energy than visible light carries.
sentences.translationRu: требует больше энергии, чем несёт видимый свет.

sentences.text: So visible light has nothing to give its energy to.
sentences.translationRu: И видимому свету нечему отдать свою энергию.

sentences.text: It passes through untouched.
Ultraviolet light does have enough energy.
Which is why glass blocks it.
And why you do not get sunburnt indoors.
sentences.translationRu: И поэтому в помещении не обгоришь.

sentences.text: The second thing is scattering.
This is what sand fails.
Sand is millions of separate grains.
Every grain has surfaces.
Light bends at every surface it crosses.
sentences.translationRu: Свет преломляется на каждой пересечённой поверхности.

sentences.text: A beam entering sand is turned
thousands of times in a millimetre.
It comes back out in all directions.
sentences.translationRu: И выходит обратно во все стороны.

sentences.text: Which is exactly what white means.
Melting removes the grains.
The atoms are frozen in a disordered mass
with no internal surfaces at all.
Nothing to bend the light on the way through.
sentences.translationRu: Преломлять свет по дороге не на чем.

sentences.text: The same explanation covers snow and ice.
sentences.translationRu: То же объяснение работает для снега и льда.

sentences.text: Both are water. One is white, one is clear.
sentences.translationRu: И то и другое — вода. Одно белое, другое прозрачное.

sentences.text: Snow is crystals with air between them.
sentences.translationRu: Снег — это кристаллы с воздухом между ними.

sentences.text: Crush the crystals and it becomes clear.
sentences.translationRu: Раздави кристаллы — и он станет прозрачным.

sentences.text: Which is why a footprint in snow
looks slightly blue and slightly transparent.
sentences.translationRu: выглядит чуть синеватым и чуть прозрачным.

sentences.text: You have just made ice with your foot.
sentences.translationRu: Ты только что сделал лёд ногой.

title: How much of an old painting is still the painting

sentences.text: A painting five hundred years old
has been cleaned, repaired and varnished
sentences.translationRu: была вычищена, починена и покрыта лаком

sentences.text: many times before you look at it.
sentences.translationRu: много раз до того, как ты на неё посмотрел.

sentences.text: The question of how much is original
has no clean answer.
Start with varnish, which causes most of it.
sentences.translationRu: Начнём с лака — он причина большей части проблем.

sentences.text: Painters varnished work to protect it.
sentences.translationRu: Художники покрывали работу лаком для защиты.

sentences.text: Varnish yellows and darkens over a century.
sentences.translationRu: За век лак желтеет и темнеет.

sentences.text: So the painting slowly turns brown.
Which is what people came to expect.
Old masters were assumed to be dark.
When a major cleaning reveals the colours
the reaction is frequently hostile.
The most famous case ran for a decade.
Critics said the cleaning had destroyed
a deliberate layer of shading.
Conservators said they had removed candle smoke.
sentences.translationRu: Реставраторы отвечали, что убрали копоть от свечей.

sentences.text: Both sides had chemistry on their side.
sentences.translationRu: Обе стороны имели за собой химию.

sentences.text: Because both were partly right.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что обе были отчасти правы.

sentences.text: Then there is loss, which is not reversible.
sentences.translationRu: Есть ещё утраты, и они необратимы.

sentences.text: Paint flakes. Canvas tears. Panels split.
sentences.translationRu: Краска осыпается. Холст рвётся. Доски трескаются.

sentences.text: Somebody has to decide what goes in the gap.
sentences.translationRu: Кто-то должен решить, что будет в лакуне.

sentences.text: The old answer was to paint it convincingly.
A skilled restorer could make a hole vanish.
sentences.translationRu: Умелый реставратор мог сделать утрату невидимой.

sentences.text: Which produced a second problem.
Nobody later could tell what was whose.
sentences.translationRu: Позже никто не мог сказать, что чьё.

sentences.text: The modern rule inverts it.
A repair must be visible on inspection
sentences.translationRu: Вставка должна быть заметна при осмотре

sentences.text: and invisible from a normal distance.
Fine vertical lines, or a slightly flatter tone.
sentences.translationRu: Тонкая вертикальная штриховка или чуть более плоский тон.

sentences.text: Step close and the repair announces itself.
sentences.translationRu: Подойди ближе — и вставка заявляет о себе.

sentences.text: Everything must also be reversible.
Whatever is added must come off
with a solvent that does not touch the original.
That rule exists because of the previous century.
sentences.translationRu: Это правило существует из-за прошлого века.

sentences.text: Which added things that cannot be removed.
sentences.translationRu: Который добавил то, что снять нельзя.

sentences.text: Underneath is a philosophical question
sentences.translationRu: Под всем этим лежит философский вопрос,

sentences.text: that conservators argue about openly.
Is the object the thing being preserved?
Or the artist's intention?
Those two diverge the moment anything fades.
sentences.translationRu: Эти два расходятся в момент, когда что-то выцветает.

sentences.text: Restore the colour and you have the intention.
Leave it and you have the object.
There is no position that keeps both.
sentences.translationRu: Позиции, которая сохранит оба, не существует.
